import collections
N = int(input())
AC = [list(map(int, input().split())) for _ in range(N)]

# Group beans by color and find the minimum deliciousness for each color
color_to_min_deliciousness = collections.defaultdict(lambda: float('inf'))
for deliciousness, color in AC:
    if deliciousness < color_to_min_deliciousness[color]:
        color_to_min_deliciousness[color] = deliciousness

# Find the maximum of these minimum deliciousness values
max_min_deliciousness = max(color_to_min_deliciousness.values())
print(max_min_deliciousness)
